common.newVersion: ✦ New version ready – tap to update

login.tagline: Teams, rooms, choreography and competitions – one place for the whole school.
login.noAccount: First time? Use your e-mail – you create your profile afterwards.
login.codeSent: We sent an e-mail to {{email}}. Tap the link in it – or enter the code here if the e-mail has one. Check spam too.
login.demoHint: Demo: any 6-digit code works. admin@demo = Line, parent@demo = parent, maja@demo = trainer, new address = create profile.

register.title: Create profile
register.intro: Tell us who you are. Line approves your profile and places you on the right teams.
register.rolesHint: Pick several if needed – e.g. parent and trainer.
register.tooYoung: Dancers under 13 don't sign up themselves: a parent signs up and adds the child. From age 10 the parent can then give the child a supervised profile.
register.childHint: Under 10: no login – you see and reply on the child's behalf. 10–12: you can give the child a supervised profile you control. 13+: own account.
register.wishedTeamsPh: E.g. The AXIS, Hip Hop Mini…
register.terms: By signing up you accept the

pending.title: Thanks, {{name}}
pending.body: Line has received your sign-up and is looking at it – usually the same day. You'll get an e-mail and a message here as soon as you're in.
pending.step2: You're put on your teams with the right role
pending.step3: You get an e-mail – and the app opens automatically
pending.rejectedBody: Contact LL Dance Studio if you think this is a mistake.

team.noneYet: Line hasn't placed you on a team yet.
team.rosterStaffOnly: Contact details are visible to the team's staff only.
team.noTrophiesYet: No trophies yet – first competition is {{event}} on {{date}}.
team.noTeamMessages: No messages to the team yet.
team.childNoDancerTeams: {{name}} is not a dancer on any team yet – as a parent you only follow teams where {{name}} dances. ({{name}} trains {{teams}}.)
team.childNoTeams: Line has not put {{name}} on a team yet.

home.phase1: Phase 1: sign-in, profile and approval. Schedule, feed and events come next.
home.eventsHint: Sign-up and pack list under More → Events.

admin.usersIntro: New profiles await your approval. Put each person on teams with a role, then press Approve.
admin.parentOnly: Parent without a dancer role – choose teams for the children only.
admin.makeAdmin: Make admin (full access to the whole school)
admin.approved: {{name}} is approved and has been notified.
admin.membersSub: Everyone approved – teams, roles, child profiles
admin.seasonSub: This week's trainings in both rooms
admin.phase2note: Phase 2: users, members, teams, season plan and bookings. Messages, shop, punch cards and events come in phases 3–4.
admin.closedHint: Admission by audition – shown as closed on the website
admin.parentsSeeVideoHint: On for mini/kids. Parents of children under 13 always see everything.
admin.punchHint: When you activate a card, the person is put on every team with punch cards open.
admin.seasonHint: Tap a training to change time, room or trainer – pick "this and all future" for the whole season. A new training with "repeat weekly" fills the whole season at once.
admin.messagesIntro: Messages everyone must read or accept. You can see who is missing.
admin.reportsIntro: Reported posts and comments land here. Hide or keep – ideally within 24 hours.
admin.phase3note: Phase 3: team rooms, trainer channel, messages with receipts, folders, choreography and notes. Events, punch cards and shop come in phase 4.
admin.phase4note: Phase 4: events, shop, punch cards, milestones and in-app notifications. Public website comes in phase 5.
admin.teamPublicHint: The team is listed on the website with style, level and training time (never names or photos)
admin.teamDescriptionPh: Who is the team for, what do you dance, how to join?
admin.isAdminHint: Full access to the whole school – same as Line. You cannot remove yourself.
admin.importSub: Zip with one folder per team → team folders + covers
admin.importIntro: Pick a zip with one folder per team (e.g. from Google Drive). Each folder goes into the team's folder and the first image becomes the team cover. Photos are private – only the team, parents and trainers see them.
admin.importCover: Use first image as team cover
admin.importHint: Large zips take time on mobile data – use a computer. Safe to run again; existing files are skipped.
admin.sizeTypesHint: Pick one or more sets – adjust the list below if a size is missing or should go.

admissionHint.open: Anyone can sign up – 2 free trial lessons.
admissionHint.tryout: Open team, but the trainer assesses level after trial lessons. Shown as a badge on the website.
admissionHint.audition: Admission only through audition/selection. Shown as a badge on the website and in the app.

admin.admissionNotePh: Note, e.g. “Audition 15 August at 10” or “4 trial lessons”
admin.installmentsHint: 2/4/10 instalments with a 50 kr. fee per instalment
admin.priceNotePh: Note, e.g. “Remaining 975 kr. after 4 trial lessons” or “Paid with punch card”
admin.pricesHint: Used at sign-up on the website and in the app. Sign-up price = what is paid at sign-up if lower than the full season.
admin.inviteSub: Create a person directly – they get an e-mail with the app link and sign in with their e-mail. No approval needed.
admin.invited: {{name}} is created and has received an e-mail.
admin.inviteExists: A person with that e-mail already exists.
admin.roleDancerSub: Dances on one or more teams
admin.roleParentSub: Sees the children's teams, reports absence and pays
admin.roleStaffSub: Can take attendance, write to the team and upload videos
admin.accessNone: No teams yet – the person only sees the home screen.
admin.loginNone: No own login – seen via a parent
admin.noChildrenYet: No children linked yet. Search for an existing child or create a new one.
admin.needsAge: Requires age {{min}}+ – fix the birth date if it is wrong
admin.loginPending: Signs in with {{email}} – has not logged in yet
admin.teamsHint: Tap the role next to the team.
admin.addChildFirst: Add a child under Children first
admin.notSelf: You cannot change your own admin status
admin.seasonDragHint: On a computer: drag a training to another day to move it – you are asked whether it applies to all weeks and warned about conflicts.
admin.teamsParentOnly: The parent automatically follows the teams where the children dance (marked below).
admin.childrenHint: The parent gets access to exactly the teams where the child is a dancer – not teams where the child is a trainer. Teams are chosen on the child (Edit).
admin.cardActivated: Punch card activated – {{name}} has the punches

settings.childLoginExplain: The child signs in with their own e-mail and sees schedule, video and team room. You see all of it via "View as".
settings.childLoginOffer: {{name}} can get a supervised profile that you control.
settings.childLoginGranted: {{name}} can now sign in – the code goes to the child's e-mail
settings.childConsent: By giving access you consent as a parent to your child using the app. You can close the profile at any time.
settings.childOwnAccount: From 13 the dancer creates their own profile.
settings.deleteSure: Are you sure you want to delete your account?
settings.deleteExplain: Your profile, your children's profiles without their own login, posts, photos and sign-ups are deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteLastAdmin: You are the school's only admin – make someone else admin first.

session.planPh: Warm-up 10 min · Technique: pirouettes · Choreo: verse 2 counts 1–32 (see video) · Notes: Ida has a sore foot
session.absenceCopyChild: You report on the child's behalf.
session.noRoster: No dancers on this team yet.
session.subRequested: Trainers notified – someone will take it
session.subTaken: You're the substitute – the team is notified
session.cancelInfo: The team and parents are notified and {{room}} becomes free.
session.cancelPh: E.g. Cancelled due to illness – see you next week!
session.title: Title
session.autoBook: The room is booked automatically. Overlaps in the same room are rejected.
session.useTeamStaff: Use the team's trainer and assistant
session.badUntil: End date must be after start date
session.futureHint: If you change day or time, every future week moves too – you are told about conflicts first.
session.conflictsSub: The room is taken at the new time in these weeks:

rooms.legend: Trainings from the season plan book the rooms automatically. Tap a free hour to book for solo/duo – Line approves.
rooms.staffBooks: As trainer/admin the room is booked immediately.
rooms.needsApproval: Your booking is sent to Line for approval.
rooms.taken: The room is taken in that slot.
rooms.sentForApproval: Sent for approval – you'll be notified

feed.title: Posts
feed.rules: Be kind and respectful – the trainers and Line read along. Report anything that isn't okay.
feed.empty: No posts yet. Be the first!
feed.reported: Thanks – Line will look at it

msg.title: Messages
msg.parentsToo: Parents of dancers on the team get the message too.

folders.name: Name
folders.staffOnlyHint: Only trainers and assistants can see the folder
folders.privacy: Photos are visible to the team, parents and trainers only – never public.

choreo.title: Title
choreo.uploadHint: Record in landscape. Large files take time on mobile data.
choreo.privacy: Choreography is for the team's dancers and trainers only (parents only on mini/kids teams).
choreo.loopHint: Press A at the start and B at the end – the video repeats that part. “8 counts” loops 8 counts from now at the chosen tempo (BPM).
choreo.noFile: No video file on this one.
choreo.noFormations: No formations yet – the trainer makes them on a choreography video.
choreo.pickDancer: Pick a dancer, tap the stage
choreo.editHint: Pick initials and tap where the dancer stands. Tap a dot to move it.
choreo.notesPh: Counts, what to practise, who starts where …
choreo.formationsIntro: Formations belong to the choreography videos. Pick a video to see or edit its formations.

notes.title: Notes
notes.emptyStaff: No notes yet. Pick a dancer to write.
notes.hint: Notes are written by the trainers and visible only to you (and your parents).
notes.hintStaff: Notes are private to the team's staff – dancers and parents never see them.

more.settingsSub: Profile, child accounts, language, sign out

events.title: Events
events.paidClaimed: Thanks – Line marks the payment when received.
events.name: Title
events.planField: Plan (one line per item, start with the time)

shop.title: Shop
shop.hint: Payment via MobilePay. Items are handed out at the studio once Line has seen the payment.
shop.claimed: Thanks – Line checks MobilePay and marks the order paid.

punch.title: Punch cards
punch.intro: Punch cards are valid on: {{teams}}. A punch is used automatically when the trainer marks you present.
punch.none: No punch cards for sale right now.
punch.hint: Line activates the card once payment is received – then you are on the team automatically.
punch.claimed: Thanks – Line activates the card once payment is received.
punch.notForOthers: Other teams pay a season fee and do not use punches.

pay.title: Season payments
pay.joinSub: Yourself or your child on another team – family discount applied automatically
pay.familyHint: Family discount: full price for the most expensive team, 10 % off every further team – applied automatically.
pay.joinSend: Sign up and go to payment
pay.already: Already on the team or signed up.
pay.adminSub: Season payments, website sign-ups, send payment requests with a discount
pay.adminHint: “Mark paid” puts the dancer on the team, approves the profile and sends a receipt by e-mail.
pay.noDancers: No dancers on the team yet.
pay.messagePh: e.g. “Special deal – half price in spring”
pay.ratesText: Line gets back to you about payment.
pay.feeHint: Instalments: {{fee}} kr. per instalment – only one fee per instalment, however many teams.

milestones.title: Milestones
milestones.empty: No milestones yet – they come from the trainers.

view.hint: Preview the app through another role – server permissions are unchanged.
view.blocked: Dancers on this team ({{years}}) are under {{age}} and have no login of their own. Parents see the team, trainings and photos.

badges.title: Emblems
badges.emptyTeam: No emblems yet – the first come when attendance is taken (10 in a row 🔥) or when a trainer gives one.

catalog.title: Image catalogue
catalog.hint: {{n}} images in the catalogue – add new ones in public/art/catalog.
catalog.adminSub: Upload images and organise in folders
catalog.empty: No own images yet – upload the first one.
catalog.bundledHint: Built-in illustrations ship with the app and cannot be deleted.

tour.title: Hi {{name}} – shall we show you around?
tour.intro: It takes a minute. We point out the most important things in the app – you can always find the tour again under Settings.

hero.label: Next event
hero.title: The most important thing first
hero.body: Home always shows the next event – tap for details, sign-up and packing list.

team.label: Team picker
team.title: Pick team and who you view as
team.body: With several teams or children you switch here. Everything below follows.

week.label: This week
week.title: Trainings and absences
week.body: This week's trainings with hall and trainer. Report an absence in one tap – the trainer is notified.

bell.label: Notifications
bell.title: Know when something happens
bell.body: Cancellations, substitutes, messages from Line, new emblems and sign-ups land here.

profile.label: Profile
profile.title: Your profile and menu
profile.body: Language, settings, punch cards, the Star Shop and sign out. Admins find Admin here too.

rooms.label: Rooms
rooms.title: The hall calendar
rooms.body: See all trainings in both halls and book a hall for extra practice.

teamtab.label: My team
teamtab.title: The team's own space
teamtab.body: Choreography and music, team photos, dancers, trophy shelf, emblems and the team wall.

social.label: Social
social.title: The wall
social.body: Posts from the team and the whole school plus official messages from Line – in one place.

events.label: Events
events.title: Competitions, shows and shop
events.body: Upcoming events with sign-up, results and the Star Shop.

admin.label: Admin
admin.title: All admin in the app
admin.body: Users, teams, season plan, bookings, messages, events, shop and image catalogue – no console needed.

notifPrefs.promptBody: Get a notification when the trainer sends a message, a training changes, new events open and more. You choose which types under Settings.
notifPrefs.changeLater: You can always change this under Settings → Notifications.
notifPrefs.title: Notifications
notifPrefs.masterSub: Turn all notifications on or off

customize.title: Customise the app
customize.sub: Rearrange Home, new text boxes, images
customize.intro: Decide what people see on Home and in which order. Make your own boxes with text, image and link, and change the login and home images. Changes apply to everyone when you press Save.
customize.loginImageSub: The background of the login screen. Pick from the catalogue or upload your own.
customize.heroImageSub: Used on the big card at the top of Home when the event has no image of its own.
customize.saved: Saved – everyone sees the change next time they open the app.
customize.gallerySub: Pick images for the carousel on the website front page – in the order you tap ({{n}} selected). Empty = Line's team photos are shown automatically.

threads.title: Conversations
threads.toHint: Pick one or more – only the people you pick get the message.
threads.noStaff: No trainers on this team yet.
threads.subject: Subject
threads.none: No conversations yet. Write to the trainer from the team page.

form.title: Formations
form.intro: The trainer's formations: where each dancer stands at different points in the dance. Press ▶ to see the changes.
form.introStaff: Make a formation plan per dance: add frames, drag the dancers into place and note the count/time. Saves automatically.
form.name: Name of the dance
form.noFramesStaff: Press “New frame” to start – the dancers are placed automatically and you drag them into position.
form.noFrames: The trainer has not made any frames yet.
form.hint: Tap a dancer to put her on stage, then drag the dot to where she stands. The dots glide to the next frame when you press ▶.
form.mirrorHint: Mirror – as the dancers see it
form.viewAudienceHint: As the audience sees it: audience at the bottom, left/right are the audience's left/right.
form.viewDancerHint: Mirrored, as the dancers experience it standing on stage facing the audience – left and right are swapped.
